chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali ibn Uqba, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The kohl (antimony) clears the vision, promotes hair growth, and removes tears.

key_terms.الْإِثْمِدُ: Kohl or antimony, a specific type of eyeliner used for medicinal and cosmetic purposes.
key_terms.يَجْلُو: To clear, polish, or improve the clarity of.
key_terms.يُنْبِتُ: To cause to grow or sprout.

ai.seo_question: What are the health and beauty benefits of using kohl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*’s chapter on physical hygiene, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the therapeutic properties of antimony-based kohl, linking physical care to spiritual purity. It specifically notes that kohl enhances vision, stimulates eyelash growth, and reduces excessive tearing, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of utilizing natural remedies for both aesthetic and medicinal well-being.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, 
(It has been narrated) from a man from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The antimony clears the vision, and grows the hair, and removes the tears’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Faddal from Ali ibn ‘Uqbah from a man who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Al-Athmad (antimony) sharpens eye sight, grows hairs and banishes tears.’”
